title: Hierarchical Residuals: A Minimalist Decoupling of Residual Width from Compute Width
abstract: arXiv:2610.41711v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Residual connections underpin Transformers, but they implicitly tie the residual width carried through depth to the compute width used inside each layer. We introduce Hierarchical Residuals (HiRes), a minimalist architectural change that decouples these dimensions, widening the residual state while keeping per-layer compute width fixed. HiRes groups layers into blocks: standard d-dimensional PreNorm layers operate inside each block, while a wider D-dimensional PostNorm outer residual connects blocks. Learned read/write projections bridge the two spaces at block boundaries, leaving individual Transformer layers unchanged. Across different model sizes and depths, HiRes consistently outperforms vanilla residual addition, with fitted scaling laws indicating a 1.30-fold improvement in FLOPs efficiency. translated_title: 分层残差：残差宽度与计算宽度的极简解耦
translated_abstract: 残差连接是Transformer的基础，但它们隐式地将贯穿网络深度的残差宽度与每层内部使用的计算宽度绑定在一起。我们提出了分层残差（Hierarchical Residuals，HiRes），这是一种极简的架构改动，将这两个维度解耦，在保持每层计算宽度固定不变的同时拓宽残差状态。HiRes将各层分组成块：标准的d维PreNorm层在每个块内部运行，而更宽的D维PostNorm外层残差连接各个块。可学习的读/写投影在块边界处桥接这两个空间，而单个Transformer层保持不变。在不同的模型规模和深度下，HiRes始终优于原始的残差相加，拟合的缩放定律表明其FLOPs效率提升了1.30倍。在OLMoE-1B-7B的5000亿token预训练中，HiRes实现了训练损失降低0.0208、下游准确率提高1.14个百分点。HiRes还……
tldr: HiRes通过将各层分组成块，在块内保留标准残差、在块间使用更宽的外层残差，以极简改动解耦残差宽度与计算宽度，实现1.30倍FLOPs效率提升，并在OLMoE-1B-7B预训练中显著降低训练损失并提高下游准确率。
en_tdlr: HiRes is a minimalist architectural change that decouples residual width from per-layer compute width by grouping layers into blocks with a wider outer residual, yielding 1.30x FLOPs efficiency improvement and better training loss and downstream accuracy on OLMoE-1B-7B pretraining.
